capacity.title: Enough to outlast a long day.
capacity.body: 50,000 mAh in a matte-black shell. Plenty to push your phone, tablet and headset through a festival, road trip or multi-day hike — without hunting for an outlet.

devices.title: Six devices, in parallel.
devices.body: Four USB-A ports plus two built-in cables (USB-C and Lightning). Up to six devices at once — no queue, no negotiating with friends about who charges first.

ports.title: Universal outputs.
ports.body: 4× USB-A · built-in USB-C + Lightning cable. Works with virtually anything that's a phone, tablet, or game controller.

flashlight.title: Built-in flashlight.
flashlight.body: A power-button-hold activates the LED flashlight. Works independently from charging — useful in tunnels, tents, or when the power's out.

design.title: Matte black. Woven strap. LED display.
design.body: No glossy plastic that scratches on day one. No buttons you can't find in the dark. One compact shape, made to be carried.

warranty.title: Manufacturer warranty included.
warranty.body: If your unit fails under normal use, we arrange repair or replacement via the manufacturer. Email hello@titan-banks.com — no hold music, no scripts.

mission.title: Power that doesn't stop where you don't stop.
mission.intro: TitanBanks builds premium portable power for people who don't adjust their day to their battery. Our mission is to deliver dependable energy where and when it matters — without compromising on quality, durability or design.
values: Build only what we'd use ourselves — no disposable electronics.
Clear specs and honest claims — no marketing fiction.
2-year warranty and direct customer service — no call-centre maze.
Premium quality without a premium markup — direct sales, no retail margin.
Build an ecosystem — Titan X is the first step, not the last.
mission.founder_body: TitanBanks was founded by a small team that ran out of power one time too many. We're not an electronics giant with hundreds of SKUs. We're a focused power-bank brand that wants to make one product perfectly before the next.

products_page.title: One power bank. Fully considered.
products_page.intro: TitanBanks builds premium portable power. We're starting with Titan X — more is coming.
